decisions.reason: The original archive marks the exact ring unused. A later archive ties it to quest 5532, which it explicitly marks obsolete. The Forever quest still carries its never-implemented title and requires eight Argent Dawn Valor Tokens. The bind-on-pickup ring retains the historical stats. The current quest, vendor, loot and creation sources checked contain no independent grant. This review covers Horde levels 1–3 on the stated build.
